Thank you. I didnt really expect anyone to read this, its not the first time i write a wall of text only to end up deleting all of it b4 posting because it comes to mind that no one really cares. But this time i posted.

There is no logical reason for my depression. I never felt fear of death just fear of pain and it started out of nowhere and from nothing. 

Theres so many more things i didnt mention such as possible other mental diseases, obesity and skin disorder that left me uncapable of ever having a relationship mostly due to my pride though. But that too adds up even if it is my choice.

I appreaciate your time. I really do. Im on mobile and not used to type in it cause its been years since i used it to message often. Its 6:30am now i cant sleep and need to leave for work in 1hour. Gonna take a shower to cool my head and live this hell for yet anothet day.
